contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Ascorbic acid diffuses into sensor hydrogel and oxidizes at the platinum electrode, creating false electrochemical current that artificially spikes sensor glucose readings by up to 60-100 mg/dL.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Avoid megadose IV or oral Vitamin C (>500mg/day) or verify via capillary fingerstick before administering insulin.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Acetaminophen metabolites oxidize at glucose oxidase (GOx) sensing wires, creating false positive hyperglycemia alerts on older generation sensors (Dexcom G6 / FreeStyle Libre 1-2).
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Do not dose bolus insulin based on sensor readings within 6 hours of taking >1,000mg acetaminophen; Dexcom G7 has improved selective membranes but still requires caution.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Produces severe electrochemical oxidation causing dangerously false high glucose values, risking fatal insulin overdose if corrected automatically.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Strict fingerstick monitoring required. Disable automated insulin delivery (AID) closed loops.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: TENS / EMS Electrical Nerve & Muscle Stimulators
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Transthoracic or upper torso electrical stimulation pulses are oversensed by bipolar pacemaker leads as ventricular fibrillation, triggering inappropriate ICD shock therapy or pacemaker pacing inhibition (asystole).
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Absolute contraindication across upper torso, neck, and shoulders. Use only peripheral lower limbs with physician consent.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Micro-ampere alternating currents passing through footpads can interfere with cardiac lead sensing circuits.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Disable body fat impedance measurement; use standard weight mode only.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: High electromagnetic induction induces currents in pacemaker circuitry causing reset into asynchronous backup mode (VOO/DOO).
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Maintain minimum 12-inch (30cm) separation from high-magnetic wellness gadgets.

cpap_and_bipap_sleep_apnea_devices.name: CPAP & BiPAP Positive Airway Pressure Systems

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: Essential Oils & Diffuser Aromatherapy Liquids in Water Chamber
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Aerosolized terpene hydrocarbons and lipophilic oils pumped under positive pressure directly into alveoli cause chemical lipoid pneumonia, lung fibrosis, and polycarbonate water chamber degradation.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Strictly forbid adding any essential oils, eucalyptus, or perfumes to the humidifier tub. Use 100% sterile distilled water only.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Aerosolized calcium/magnesium scaling and bacterial pathogens (Acanthamoeba, Legionella) directly inhaled during sleep.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Daily chamber rinse with distilled water.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Alpha-adrenergic peripheral vasoconstriction creates artificial acute spikes (+15-25 mmHg systolic), leading to inappropriate self-escalation of antihypertensive prescriptions.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Rest 30 minutes post-caffeine ingestion before taking diagnostic readings; record baseline morning readings before morning stimulants.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: Undersized Cuff Bladder on Hypertrophic Muscular Arms
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Bladder unable to fully compress brachial artery; generates false positive Stage 2 hypertension readings (+10-18 mmHg).
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Measure mid-arm circumference; use extra-large conical cuff for arms >32cm.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Methylene blue has high optical absorbance at 660nm (the exact red wavelength used by pulse oximeters to measure deoxygenated hemoglobin), producing artificial plunge in SpO2 readings to 82-85% despite normal arterial pO2.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Do not treat artifactual desaturation if patient is alert; use co-oximetry or arterial blood gas (ABG) for true oxygenation.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: Synthetic Dark Nail Polish & Cold-Induced Raynaud Vasoconstriction
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Blocks infrared transmission or severely drops Perfusion Index (PI < 0.2), causing unreadable or erratic saturation metrics.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Warm hands or attach sensor to earlobe or remove nail lacquer.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: Thermal Exposure: Saunas, Hot Tubs, Direct Sunlight (>30°C)
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Recombinant human insulin peptides denature into inactive fibrillar polymers under heat, causing sudden unexplained diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA).
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Detach insulin pump or protect pod during thermal spa/sauna sessions; discard cartridge if exposed to ambient temps >30°C.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: Infusion Site Lipohypertrophy from Repeated Needle Piercing
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Scarred adipose tissue delays insulin absorption by up to 180 minutes followed by unpredictable late dumping, causing severe delayed nocturnal hypoglycemia.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Strict 14-day site rotation protocol across abdominal quadrants.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: Implanted Metallic Orthopedic Hardware (Spinal Cages / Screws)
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: High-density electrical current concentration around metal interfaces causes localized tissue heating and nerve irritation.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Do not cross electrical field vectors directly over fresh surgical orthopedic metal implants.

peritoneal_dialysis_and_hemodialysis_cyc.name: Peritoneal Home Dialysis Cyclers & Hemodialysis Units

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: High-Potassium Herbal Extracts (Dandelion Root, Nettle Leaf, Licorice, Horsetail)
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Renal failure patients cannot filter exogenous potassium; massive potassium release triggers fatal cardiac arrest / ventricular fibrillation.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Strict prohibition of high-potassium herbal diuretics.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: Phosphate Binders (Sevelamer, Calcium Acetate) Timing Violation
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Taking phosphate binders on an empty stomach renders them 100% ineffective; binders must physically bind dietary phosphate in gut during meals.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Must ingest binder with the very first bite of every protein-containing meal.

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: Inhaled Corticosteroid (Budesonide, Fluticasone) Mouth Rinse Neglect
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Steroid deposit on oropharyngeal mucosa causes localized immunosuppression, leading to oral candidiasis (thrush) and vocal cord dysphonia.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Vigorous water gargle and spit immediately following every steroid inhalation.

smartwatch_ecg_and_ppg_sensors.name: Smartwatch Single-Lead ECG & Optical PPG Sensors

contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.compound: Heavy Shivering, Tremors, or Active Muscular Contraction
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.mechanism: Somatic muscle electrical activity (EMG noise) creates pseudo-atrial fibrillation or baseline wander on single Lead-I ECG.
contraindicated_compounds_and_interferen.clinical_action: Sit quietly with forearm supported on flat table when recording ECG.
